verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LM Studio serves local models on OpenAI-like endpoints and a REST API, including chat completions (lm-studio-docs-5, lm-studio-docs-9, lm-studio-docs-29). However, no item mentions streaming, server-sent events, or incremental token delivery to client applications. An OpenAI-like API alone does not establish streaming support, so this applicable capability is unevidenced.
